shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: sky level above, solid rock basement below, fully simulated linked maps with live see-through air, cross-level work/hauling/power/pipes/climate, one-colony UI.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, event-driven work, and zero recurring cost when idle.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only. DBH and VEF PipeSystem as soft compat.
- Cap: 3 levels per column. Upper-level rules match Z-Levels beta semantics.
- Basement: solid mineable rock, fogged, thick-roofed, stable 12C underground; vanilla collapse rules intact.
- Robustness: ABGuard kill switches (ui, levelGen, rendering, movement, logistics, roofSync, weather, power, pipes, climate); fail open everywhere.
- All player-facing text: vanilla sentence case, ASCII only, no long dashes.

## How it works (T0-T3 signed off; T4 complete pending final run)
- Core: LevelComp registry on aligned pocket maps; stairs pairs generate levels; loss-proof StairTransfer; PageUp/PageDown level view; links severed cleanly on map removal.
- Sky mountains: contracted mass, ledge ring, lit face rows, fogged core, guaranteed mining reveal.
- See-below renderer: whitelisted content layers only; air-cells light mask; live dynamic things below; far clip 70.
- Live sync via MapEvents; weather link every 150 ticks; colony-wide tables and resource counts.
- Cross-level work, idle return, drafted gizmos; hauling (storage + construction demand + right-click); needs (bed redirect).
- Power (T4b.5): stairwells are cross-level power links: paired hidden 1000 Wd buffers, 10-tick equalization, same-cycle delivery into receiving banks at their charge efficiency, no storage presentation (conduit-style inspect line, no charge bar). Multi-megawatt effective throughput. Verified working; responsiveness tuning verified pending final run.
- Pipes (T4b, verified): DBH water and VEF PipeSystem resources equalize through stairwells; DBH sewage needs per-level handling.
- Climate (T4c): sky outdoor and seasonal temperatures mirror the surface live (seasons, snaps, waves); stairwells exchange heat vent-style between their rooms (25 units per degree per 250 ticks, clamped, toggleable).

## Threat policy (documented baseline)
- Raids, sieges, and events target the surface; pocket levels are never raid targets (vanilla pocket map semantics).
- Drop pods cannot land under built-up sky areas because sky floors write constructed roofs on the surface (coherent by construction); open-air surface cells remain valid landing spots (fiction: they fell past through open air).
- Known balance notes for future opt-ins: sky and basement are raider-free sanctuaries; basement thick roof does not attract infestations (pocket maps are not scanned). Flagged in the field manual rather than force-patched, per robustness-first policy.

## Profiling audit (T4c, clean)
Per-tick fixed: stairs Normal tick + per-map modulo checks + DrawPos idle branch (single bool read). Event-driven: roof/terrain/spawn handlers on change only. Periodic: 10t power pair equalize, 150t weather, 204t resource counts, 250t climate + pipes, 600t haul/demand caches. Per-frame only while viewing the sky level: view-culled cached section draws + mask rebuilds max 4/sec. No hot-loop allocations. Heaviest item is the view-gated below-render.

## Tranche plan
- T0-T3 DONE. T4a/T4b/T4c CODE DONE; single combined verification run pending (power feel + no storage UI + climate).
- Publishing prep per global rules: field manual in _dev, Modern Suite BBCode description + live-view HTML, Preview.png, publish-hold strip.

## Status
T4c compiled green, pushed. One combined verification run, then publishing prep.
